setup.hiddenNotice: You're signed in, but other players can't see you on the roster, standings or matchmaking until you enter a wrestler name.

setup.wrestlerHintRoster: Choose a wrestler. You'll appear on the site as soon as you save.
setup.placeholderRejected: "Needs Wrestler" is a placeholder. Enter the name you want to use.
setup.nowVisible: You're on the site now. Other players can see you.

auth.wrestlerAfterSignup: You'll enter your wrestler name after you sign in. Until then you can use your account, but you won't appear on the site.
auth.welcomeNextTitle: One step left: enter your wrestler name
auth.welcomeNextBody: You'll be asked for it when you sign in. You stay hidden from the site until you've entered one.

matchmaking.needsNameBody: Matchmaking opens up once you have a wrestler name. You're hidden from other players until then.
matchmaking.actionFailed: That didn't work. Please try again.
matchmaking.queueEmpty: Nobody is in the queue right now.
